lines.speaker: Commentator A
lines.text: That's a red card for Stonebridge Albion, and they're already a goal down.

lines.speaker: Commentator B
lines.text: The penalty goes into the top right corner, the keeper had no chance.

lines.speaker: Commentator A
lines.text: Ten men, and Stonebridge Albion win it with a solo run, no passes at all, pure individual brilliance.
